name: External Document Amount Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the nature, or use, of the amount, as published in an external document amount type code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

APDS.name: Additional Promotional Discount
APDS.definition: Addition discount based on third-party agreed business promotional activity, i.e., extra 10 percent discount for 15 days)

TMDS.name: Terms Discount
TMDS.definition: Discount based on terms negotiated for payment within a specified time period, i.e., 2/10 Net 30 (2 percent discount if paid in 10 days; otherwise, net amount is due in 30 days).

CITY.name: City Tax
CITY.definition: Tax accessed by city jurisdictions within a country.

CNTY.name: County Tax
CNTY.definition: Tax accessed by county jurisdictions within a country.

LOCL.name: Local Tax
LOCL.definition: Tax accessed by local jurisdictions within a country.

PROV.name: Province Tax
PROV.definition: Tax accessed by province jurisdictions within a country.

STAT.name: State Tax
STAT.definition: Tax accessed by state jurisdictions within a country.

CHAR.name: New Charges
CHAR.definition: Amount is new charges, for example new charges on a credit card.

INTC.name: Interest Charges
INTC.definition: Amount is interest charges, or example interest charges on a credit card.

DISC.name: Discount Applied
DISC.definition: Discount Applied. Generic usage if cannot be specified by any other discount code.
